verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference with runnable examples is a fair question for a developer framework like LiveKit Agents, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only prose docs, llms.txt and markdown endpoints, a quickstart, and the no-code Agent Builder. None of these is an interactive API reference with runnable examples: they are adjacent docs features, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
